result_json.message: review: plan 210 phase 3 exact code-review context

items.title: Late pre-author capture stamps post-work HEAD as the review base
items.reason: capturePhaseAuthorAdmission captures on any bound author render (including author-process-impl-review) even when the phase already has admitted git:commit/author commits, so in-flight or direct-recorded phases get post-work HEAD as base: reviewer render then fails permanently with CODE_DIFF_NOT_ANCESTOR, or yields an empty range that hides unreviewed work. Plan forbids stamping a fictional pre-author base. Skip capture when same-phase admitted commits exist so the legacy fallback applies; add regression test.

items.title: Continued enforced reviews rejected: priorCodeFindings never supplied by protocol validate or invoke
items.reason: Closure certification runs whenever codeContext is set but no production caller passes priorCodeFindings/priorCodeDecisions, so every prior-finding outcome yields PRIOR_FINDING_UNKNOWN and still-open items are treated as new blockers needing a hunk from the correction range. Probe: enforced round-2 verdict with F1 still_open -> valid:false, fatalCode PRIOR_FINDING_UNKNOWN. Derive open findings from the latest recorded same-phase reviewer step (already scanned for priorReviewCount) and pass them in both paths; add enforced round-2 CLI test.

items.title: Required hunk citation format differs from the rendered diff; verbatim copy rejected as WRONG_FILE
items.reason: parseCodePatch stores diff --git line + @@ body, dropping index/---/+++ lines shown in the rendered patch. Probe: verbatim file block -> CODE_HUNK_WRONG_FILE (misleading); stored text without trailing newline -> CODE_HUNK_NOT_FOUND. In enforced mode this fatally rejects the verdict. Canonicalize cited evidence (drop extended header lines before first @@, tolerate missing final terminator), document the accepted form in formatCodeReviewDiff, add tests.

items.title: Pin remaining diff config (algorithm, indent heuristic, inter-hunk context, relative)
items.reason: CODE_DIFF_OPTIONS does not override diff.algorithm, diff.indentHeuristic, diff.interHunkContext or diff.relative, so user/repo config can change hunks and patch hashes. Add --diff-algorithm=myers, --indent-heuristic, --inter-hunk-context=0, --no-relative.

items.title: Retrieval command pathspec depends on caller cwd
items.reason: codeDiffRetrievalCommand uses pathspec . without -C, but the recorded patch is computed from effectiveWorkingDirectory; running it elsewhere returns a different patch. Prefix -C <workdir> or use a root-anchored whole-tree pathspec.

items.title: Omitted-hunk detection matches by @@ header text
items.reason: formatCodeReviewDiff locates hunks via findIndex on header text, so identical @@ headers in different files resolve to the first occurrence and truncated hunks can be missing from Omitted hunk headers. Locate by file-section offset.

result_json.summary: Phase 3 git evidence boundary is strict and well tested, but three P1 wiring defects break the completion gate: late pre-author capture stamps post-work HEAD, continued enforced reviews are fatally rejected because prior findings are never threaded into closure validation, and the required hunk citation format mismatches the rendered diff. All fixes are mechanical.

result_json.message: review: phase 7 approved-credit reconciliation

result_json.summary: Phase 7 reconciliation core, arithmetic override, and paired persistence are sound in isolation (tsc, biome, 931 tests pass), but composition makes earlier-phase debt claims permanently pending in later phases, creating an unresolvable credit_unreconciled gate. Needs the multi-phase fix plus composition-level tests and advisory-mode evidence handling.

items.title: Past-phase debt claims deadlock every later phase completion
items.reason: Composition sets laterCodeChanged whenever a prior observation commit differs from the current reviewed commit, and reconciliation treats all claims with targetIndex <= currentIndex as due. A phase-1 claim reviewed in phase 2 cannot be carried forward and fresh realization is rejected CREDIT_CLAIM_WRONG_PHASE, so it stays pending and emits credit_unreconciled on every readiness proposal (confirmed by probe). Fix: past-phase claims keep their last settled reconciliation from their target phase; restrict code-change invalidation to same-phase assessments; add two-phase tests.

items.title: No composition-level tests for reconciliation persistence and routing
items.reason: All new tests call reconcileApprovedCredits directly with hand-built priorAssessments; nothing tests composeImplementationReviewerRecord returning reconciliation, the paired append persisting the reconciliation line, gate-cause downgrade of complete to human_gate, rejection propagation through protocol validate/invoke, or the two-phase regression. Add them to implementation-review-context tests.

items.title: Evidence SHA check hard-rejects advisory recording and requires the full 40-char SHA
items.reason: validateRealization requires evidence to include the full reviewed commit and composition errors in every mode, aborting the record. Plan says missing semantic evidence becomes advisory diagnostics. Accept an unambiguous prefix of at least 7 chars and in non-enforced mode downgrade evidence-reference failure to a diagnostic that leaves the claim pending; keep structural failures as errors.

items.title: humanDebtDecisions and bindingEvidence are never supplied by production composition
items.reason: Checklist marks decision adjustment and stale binding evidence rejection complete, but composition passes neither, so those paths are unit-test-only. Wire the binding hashes now and add an explicit Phase 8 hand-off note for implementation debt decisions in the plan.

items.title: Waiver without any observation mints realized credit without evidence
items.reason: An active waiver with no assessment yields status waived and realizedN += approvedMagnitude (e.g. realizedCredit 2 with no measurement). Plan says missing due credit is not spendable and waivers change the envelope, not the measured post-state; whether waived-unmeasured credit counts as realized is a policy decision.

items.title: Ineligible known ledger claim IDs are silently accepted
items.reason: known includes non-intrinsic/non-negative ledger claim IDs; realizations for them pass validation and are silently dropped via continue. Reject with CREDIT_CLAIM_UNKNOWN as the error text and plan require.

items.title: Minor cleanups in reconciliation composition
items.reason: reviewedCommit falls back to observation.createdAt (a timestamp); supersedesId mixes observation and reconciliation IDs; findingArchitectureDeltas is a dead void-ed parameter; carriedAssessment has a redundant branch.

result_json.guidance: A waiver without measured post-state evidence receives zero realized credit. Waiver adjusts the governing approved obligation/credit envelope and preserves original claim/evidence history; it cannot mint realizedN/D or manufacture an assessment. Fix all auto_fix findings in the Phase 7 review, including past-phase settled-claim carry-forward and composition tests.
